title: Ship keyboard and assistive semantics before visual polish
problemCues: New control or workflow without proven keyboard path
preconditions: Interactive UI in a supported web stack
decision: Name focus order, roles, and recoverable errors before craft polish. Follow W3C APG patterns for custom widgets. Automated axe checks are necessary but not sufficient.
tradeoffs: Slower first paint of visual design
exceptions: Static editorial content with no custom widgets
example: DataGrid row actions operable by keyboard
validatedBy: measure + usability objects; critical a11y findings block completion
